newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE CLEARS PIRAEUS BANK RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: GREECE CLEARS PIRAEUS BANK RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: The Athens bourse approved the 15.8 billion drachma rights issue by Greece's private Piraeus Bank , it said on Thursday.
The company will issue 5,880,000 new common registered shares at 2,500 drachmas. The terms will be seven new shares per 10 outstanding.
A total of 440,000 shares will also be privately placed with staff and subsidiary businesses at the same price.
Piraeus Bank will use proceeds to finance its investment programme which includes the expansion of branch network, acquisitions in the financial sector and increase in automation of transactions.
It will also chanell funds into subsidiary operations in Greece and abroad.
